title: Jammy Flaky Venezuelan Linguine Pasta
description: A sweet and indulgent take on traditional Venezuelan cuisine featuring linguine pasta, rendered fat, and a variety of spices.
instructions: Combine linguine pasta, duck fat, and 1 cup of water in a medium saucepan over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook until the pasta is al dente, about 8-10 minutes.
In a separate saucepan, combine the brown sugar, dried apricots, and 1/4 cup of water over medium heat, stirring occasionally.
Cook the mixture until the sugar has dissolved and the apricots are tender, about 5 minutes.
In a small bowl, whisk together the coconut milk, eggs, vanilla extract, salt, cinnamon, and nutmeg.
Add the flour to the coconut milk mixture and whisk until smooth.
Gradually add the wet ingredients to the cooked pasta, stirring constantly.
Cook over low heat for 2-3 minutes, until the mixture has thickened slightly.
Stir in the butter until melted.
Transfer the pasta to a 1-quart mason jar and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
To serve, scoop the jammy pasta into individual serving cups and drizzle with additional duck fat, if desired.
Serve chilled or at room temperature.
Garnish with toasted coconut flakes or chopped nuts, if desired.
Store leftover pasta in the refrigerator for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 2 months.
When ready to serve, thaw frozen pasta overnight in the refrigerator and reheat in the microwave or oven until warmed through.
Reserve some duck fat for serving, if desired.
You can make the pasta ahead of time and refrigerate it for up to a day before serving.
This dish is perfect for a special occasion or a fun brunch gathering.
